images.title: Tilted square of dots
images.purpose: Show that a tilted 4 by 4 square of dots has rows 1, 2, 3, 4, 3, 2, 1 with total 16.
images.composition: One diamond of dots centred, with the sum line below.
images.exact_structure: One diamond of dots in 7 horizontal rows centred on a vertical line, with 1, 2, 3, 4, 3, 2, 1 dots from top to bottom, 16 dots in all, equal size and evenly spaced. The widest row of 4 dots is amber #E69F00, the other rows teal #0072B2. Two labels only. Exactly 7 rows.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
a diamond whose rows are not 1, 2, 3, 4, 3, 2, 1
images.takeaway: A tilted square has rows that count up and then down.
images.description: A diamond of 16 dots in seven rows of 1, 2, 3, 4, 3, 2, 1, the middle row amber, with 4 × 4 = 16 below.
images.context: Shown with the concept as its one key picture, next to the walkthrough video. PLACEHOLDER: specified, not generated yet.
images.teaching_notes: Ask the student to count the dots row by row from the top and say the total.

image_decisions.why: The tilted square is the one picture behind the up-and-down sums.
